name: Aesthetic Split
description: 4 days, cutting phase, focused on lats, side delts, abs, and legs

exercises.name: Incline Smith Press
exercises.notes: Full stretch at bottom, squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Cable Fly Low to High
exercises.notes: Cables at lowest point, pull upward in arc.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: Flare rope at bottom. Elbows pinned.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Best lat builder. Add weight progressively.

exercises.name: Single Arm DB Row
exercises.notes: Incline bench 30 degrees. Pull elbow back.

exercises.name: Incline DB Curl
exercises.notes: Full long head stretch. Builds the peak.

exercises.name: Worlds Greatest Stretch
exercises.notes: T-spine plus hip flexor plus hamstring.

exercises.name: Single Leg Calf Raise
exercises.notes: On a step for full ROM.

exercises.name: DB Shrugs
exercises.notes: Push weight up from Pull day.

exercises.name: Rope Overhead Extension
exercises.notes: Long head. Makes arms look big.

name: 3-Day Lift + 2-Day Cardio Plan
description: Simple split with cardio built in.
